card.name: Inside long drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long drug names split into parts, such as the 'art' in irbesartan or 'sav' in temsavir. Also fires on the odd name-ending piece in non-English names.

modes.label: Drug name middles
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic drug name, just before its ending.

modes.label: Foreign name pieces
modes.description: A middle or end piece of a Dutch or Icelandic word or name.
